sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Observability must reveal how a task moves through a hierarchy of agents and dependencies.

- Observability must reveal how a task moves through a hierarchy of agents and dependencies.
- 26.1 Example complete execution trace Trace: supplier investigation 7.2 seconds Verified report Illustrative trace with nested MCP calls, a remote A2A task and overlapping specialist branches.
- 26.2 Trace hierarchy The trace should distinguish a logical agent execution from individual model calls and tool calls.
- 26.3 What to record A useful span or structured event may include: Do not collect raw confidential conversations, credentials or private model reasoning merely to obtain observability.
- Use structured decisions, tool-call metadata, sanitized results and evidence references.

sections.title: 26.3 What to record
sections.body:
A useful span or structured event may include:

```json
{
  "workflow_id": "WF-101",
  "task_id": "TASK-104",
  "parent_task_id": "TASK-101",
  "agent_role": "finance",
  "agent_version": "v3",
  "operation": "budget_verification",
  "attempt": 1,
  "duration_ms": 1800,
  "model_calls": 2,
  "tool_calls": 1,
  "outcome": "verified"
}
```

Do not collect raw confidential conversations, credentials or private model reasoning merely to obtain observability.

Use structured decisions, tool-call metadata, sanitized results and evidence references.

Define detect → mitigate → validate loops around the concept
Only optimize prompts and ignore systems design
quiz.explanation: Production GenAI systems need explicit detection, mitigation, and validation around every critical concept.
